summary:
SpaceDoctor is an all-in-one personal health workspace for informed action in space: 

- An AI-powered health monitoring software platform designed to connect daily monitoring with understandable trends, approved guidance and documented follow-up

- Essential health-related workflows: Vitals & Symptoms, Sleep & Fatigue, Nutrition & Hydration, Exercise & Recovery, Well-being & Support, Medication & Care.

- SpaceDoctor Assistant: recommendations, approved first-aid guidance and feature instructions.
